title: Subject Pronouns
summary: Subject pronouns come before the verb. I and you are the same for singular and plural in English. He = male, she = femal
rule: Subject pronouns come before the verb. I and you are the same for singular and plural in English. He = male, she = female, it = things/animals. They = plural.

commonMistakes.explanation: Her is possessive/object; use she as subject.

tutorHints: Contrast she vs her early to prevent later errors.
